symptoms: Dark brown to black spots with concentric rings on older leaves
Stem lesions causing collar rot in severe cases
organic_treatment: Spray neem seed kernel extract (5%) or copper oxychloride solution; prune affected lower foliage and improve air circulation.
chemical_treatment: Foliar spray of Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1 ml/L.
prevention: Rotate crops with non-solanaceous plants, avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation, and use mulch to prevent soil splashing.

symptoms: Spindle-shaped or elliptical lesions with grayish centers and dark brown borders
Neck rot causing whiteheads or empty panicles
Rapid wilting during high humidity periods
organic_treatment: Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/L or botanicals like garlic bulb extract.
chemical_treatment: Foliar spray of Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/L.
prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer application, maintain optimal water drainage, and use blast-resistant seed varieties.

symptoms: Linear stripes of bright yellow-orange pustules along leaf veins
Powdery yellow spores rubbing off onto fingers
Premature leaf drying and stunted grain filling
organic_treatment: Early sanitation and biological control using Trichoderma viride seed treatment.
chemical_treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1 ml/L immediately at first sign of pustules.
prevention: Sow rust-resistant wheat varieties (e.g., HD-2967, DBW-187) and monitor early season cool humid conditions.

disease_name: Bacterial Blight / Angular Leaf Spot (Xanthomonas citri pv. malvacearum)
symptoms: Water-soaked angular spots bounded by leaf veinlets
Black arm symptoms on stems and rotting of young bolls
organic_treatment: Seed treatment with cow urine slurry and copper-based biopesticides.
chemical_treatment: Foliar spray of Copper Oxychloride 50% WP (2.5 g/L) + Streptocycline (100 mg/L).
prevention: Delinting of seeds with sulfuric acid and destroying post-harvest crop residues.
